items.lede: The electric-auto maker says it has invited some buyers to reserve a personal robotaxi. The arrangement raises big questions about the future of car ownership.
items.title: Tesla’s Cybercab Is the Subscription Hell They Told You Not to Worry About

items.lede: Tesla can restrict where Cybercabs drive and even block owners from reselling them.
items.title: Tesla’s $30,000 Cybercab comes with a $299 monthly catch
